title: bug: Gracefully handle failed extension updates in extension-manager.ts

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides a clear, actionable bug report regarding extension update failures destroying previous working extensions. It identifies the exact source file (packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.ts), line location, and existing TODO comment, with explicit reproduction context.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: The bug fix is localized to a single file (packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.ts). It requires creating a temporary backup directory of the extension before updating/uninstalling, wrapping the update and loading step in a try/catch block, and restoring the backup if extension loading fails.

summary.problem: When updating an extension in extension-manager.ts, the existing extension directory is uninstalled and overwritten before loading the new extension. If loadExtension fails, the user is left with a broken or deleted extension.
summary.root_cause: The extension update process does not create a backup copy of the existing extension directory prior to deleting and overwriting it, so failures during extension loading cannot roll back to the previous working version.
summary.context: There is an existing TODO comment in packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.ts at line 450 noting that failed loadExtension calls should restore a backup of the old extension.

steps: In packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.ts, update installOrUpdateExtension to create a backup copy of the existing extension directory prior to uninstalling/overwriting it when isUpdate is true.
Wrap the extension installation and loadExtension call in a try/catch block.
If loadExtension or installation steps fail during an update, catch the error, restore the backup directory to the original destination path, and re-load the previous extension version.
Clean up any temporary backup directory created during the update in a finally block or after a successful update/restore.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: When an extension update fails during loadExtension, extension-manager should catch the error, restore the old extension files from backup, reload the previous working extension, and rethrow/report the failure gracefully.
verification_steps: Add a unit test in packages/cli/src/config/extension-manager.test.ts simulating a failed extension update where loadExtension throws an error.
Verify that the extension directory content is restored to the pre-update state.
Verify that the previous extension version is reloaded.
Verify that temporary backup directories are cleaned up after the failure handling.
